projects.title: Desktop Docs
projects.description:
A desktop app for Mac to search files with AI. 

With Desktop Docs you can search files by their content, instead of relying on file names and tags. 

The search is powered by a multi-modal vision and language model that works offline. Data is kept private and never shared online.
